capabilities: Chat with AI over the whole vault with streaming responses and saved history
Read, search, create and modify vault files, and add wikilinks between notes
Enumerate installed plugins and their commands
Search, install and reconfigure community plugins after explicit confirmation
Run a local HTTP MCP server so external agents like Codex can call 15 tools
extras: Desktop-only (needs the local proxy and Node file access); documentation is in Chinese; all write operations require explicit confirmation and the MCP token is stored in data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat that can read and act on the whole vault, manage plugins, and edit their configurations.

summary: AI chat assistant that runs through a local cc-switch proxy to organize vault files, build note links, install plugins, and expose MCP tools to agents.
